verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs cover internal note linking that forms 'a network of knowledge' (obsidian-docs-18). A community comment confirms notes have links and backlinks, though it describes them only as inputs to a third-party AI plugin (obsidian-comm-7). Graph view shows note relationships visually, but that is an adjacent feature rather than in-context backlinks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of [[wiki-style]] link syntax, a backlinks panel showing each backlink in context, unlinked-mention detection, independent hands-on corroboration of backlink/unlinked-mention behavior.
